feature: Mobile Lists restyle bundle (grid, tabs, cards, sheet, toast, headshot ring, switch, table sticky column, tier labels, empty/loading/error states)
detail: The data and behaviour exist in src/components/lists/v2/* (lists-page-v2.tsx, list-gallery-card.tsx, cover-tile.tsx, list-body.tsx, list-row-parts.tsx) and src/components/ui/{sheet,toast,switch,avatar}.tsx. These need mobile layouts on the m-* tokens. Fix the prototype bugs rather than copying them: 1 player singular (the card at list-gallery-card.tsx:186 also says '1 players'), collages with 1 or 3 heads drawn off-centre, the broken table divider.

feature: Dock (bottom tab bar) rebuild
detail: src/components/layout/bottom-tabs.tsx is the legacy 64px ink bar (Home/Lists/Players/Search/More, lime active). Rebuild it in place to the 84px dark dock with a real active state.

feature: Dock items and Lists' place in the IA
detail: The spec dock is Home/Community/Leagues/Profile; the README says Players instead of Leagues. Community and Leagues are flag-off at launch (feature-flags.ts). The spec moves Lists under Profile › My stuff, and the Lists back chevron currently lands on League › Match. Needs an IA ruling.

feature: Tier colour rule (TIERC vs app BAND_RAMP)
detail: bucket-colors.ts BAND_RAMP runs red→teal and cycles. The spec's TIERC is blue, purple, green, gold, red, teal, then grey from Tier 7. The README says tiers cycle. Pick one rule.

feature: Time-frame control (Week N / Last 3 / Season) with stat aggregation
detail: Weekly player_stats exist (fetch-weekly-stats.ts, aggregate-fantasy.ts), but /api/players/builder returns only season totals. Extend the endpoint for week and last-3 aggregation. Use the live current week from nfl-state, not the hard-coded 5.

feature: Cover colour swatches (6 user-chosen colours)
detail: lists has no colour column. cover-tile.tsx coverBg() derives the colour from position_filter, per Chris's 2026-08-11 ruling. Needs a ruling plus a lists.cover_color column. The black swatch turns white in dark mode.

feature: Save stat columns and time frame with the list
detail: The spec saves stats[] and tf per list as the viewer default. D3 (2026-08-09) makes cols session-only, and list-display-store.test.ts enforces that. Needs a ruling plus a column.

feature: Editor save model (draft + Save vs autosave)
detail: The spec edits a local draft, saves explicitly, and Back discards silently. The app writes every change immediately through use-lists.ts mutations. Recommend autosave with Save relabelled Done.

feature: Ranked off + Tiers on combination
detail: ranking_mode has only unranked/ranked/rank_and_tier (migration 012: hide_order wins). The spec's two toggles are independent. Needs an enum change or a ruling.

feature: More than 6 tiers
detail: TIER_VALUES is S–F (6) and list_players_tier_check (081) / BUCKET_KEY_PATTERN enforce it. Spec Auto tiers allows up to 7 breaks (8 tiers) and Add tier line is unlimited. Widen the vocabulary or cap the UI at 6.

feature: Full-screen New list step (name, description, thumbnail, video, pinned CTA)
detail: Replaces the list-form-dialog.tsx modal on mobile. POST /api/lists already accepts description. The orphaned /app/lists/new legacy builder route is free to reuse.

feature: Description field at creation
detail: lists.description (≤500) is accepted by createListSchema, but the create dialog has no field. It is editable later in list-details-tab.tsx.

feature: Thumbnail picker plus image upload
detail: POST /api/lists/[id]/thumbnail exists (5MB; png/jpeg/webp/gif; list-thumbnails bucket) but has no UI. The old picker editable-thumbnail.tsx was deleted, and lists-cutover.test.ts keeps that filename deleted, so use a new name. Create the list first, then upload.

feature: Switch back to Collage after an upload / persisted cover mode
detail: updateListSchema has no thumbnail_url and the thumbnail route has no DELETE. Needs a cover-mode field or PATCH support to clear or restore the image.

feature: Video-frame cover
detail: thumbnail_url is only writable through upload. Needs PATCH to accept i.ytimg.com/vi//hqdefault.jpg (or a cover-mode column). next.config.mjs has no remotePatterns, so use or add the host.

feature: YouTube video attach (link field, validation, attached card, video card in list view, Video badge on cards)
detail: list_links (080) covers it: kind video, title NOT NULL, ≤10 per list, http/https only via links-service.ts. Parse the YouTube id client-side, tightened to YouTube hosts. The thumbnail is a fixed i.ytimg.com URL (no scraping). The card's Video badge needs has_video in the GET /api/lists payload. Auto-fetching the title via oEmbed needs Chris's OK.

feature: Edit details screen (rename, description, thumbnail, colour, video)
detail: The spec's variant is unreachable. The app has form mode=edit, inline rename in the hero, and description and links in the details tab. Wire an entry from the List view or editor.

feature: Full-screen List editor screen
detail: The app edits inline in list-detail-panel.tsx and has no editor route. Mobile needs a dedicated screen covering title, Ranked/Tiers toggle cards, stat chips, the tools row and the 'n players · drag to reorder' info line.

feature: Ranked toggle honoured in rows
detail: list-body.tsx always renders #rank, even when ranking_mode is 'unranked'. The data exists; the UI must hide the number column.

feature: Tier lines (add, drag, merge) relabelled Tier N
detail: The app stores a tier letter on each player (list_players.tier); the spec stores positional markers. Map a tier line to the point where the letter changes. Writes go through PATCH .../players/[playerId]/tier one at a time; a bulk tier route is advisable.

feature: Auto tiers
detail: No auto-tier code exists. Use projections (players.projected_pts_*) instead of the spec's Scout AI score. Same per-player tier writes as tier lines. Don't toast success with ≤2 players.

feature: Editor row mini stats (season Pts / Avg / Pos rk)
detail: Season points and the whole pool are available from /api/players/builder. The spec's own mismatch with the chosen stat columns (gap 13) is an open question.

feature: Add players bottom sheet (search name+team, position chips, full results, +/✓ toggle that removes)
detail: list-toolbar.tsx AddPlayersPopover searches by name only, caps at 8 results and disables added rows. /api/players/builder supports positions; DELETE /api/lists/[id]/players/[playerId] exists.

feature: Scout AI overall rank (pick-sheet sort and 'Scout AI #N' sub line)
detail: No stored Scout AI ranking exists; /api/lists/generate is on-demand only. /api/players/builder sorts by projection, then ADP. Interim: projection order.

feature: Add stats sheet with 6 grouped categories
detail: list-stats.ts STAT_CATALOG has 7 stats (ADP, Cost PPR, Proj, 2026 pts, 2025 pts, Bye, SOS). Grow it to the spec's groups using the available data (Proj, Pts, Avg pts, Tgt, Rec, Rec yds, Rush att, Rush yds, Pass yds, Pass TD, Int, Cmp %, Snap %, Tgt share, Users, Pos rk). Decide whether ADP, Cost, Bye and SOS stay.

feature: Stat: Users rank
detail: consensus_rankings.consensus_position_rank exists but is season-wide, not per week or scoring. The consensus flag is off.

feature: Stat: Snap % and Tgt share
detail: player_usage holds these as season-level values only (sync/usage.ts), so the time frame cannot apply.

feature: Stat: ECR (expert consensus rank)
detail: No expert-consensus feed exists. persona_source_rankings is per persona and flag-gated.

feature: Stat: Scout AI rank
detail: Needs a stored per-week AI ranking job.

feature: Stats: Route % and Rush share
detail: player_usage has only snap_pct and target_share. Rush share needs a usage-sync extension plus a column. Route % needs a routes data source.

feature: Stats: YAC, aDOT, YPRR, YCO/att, RYOE
detail: player_stats.advanced (migration 109) exists but nothing is ingested. stat-keys.ts lists only placeholder advanced keys.

feature: Scoring choice for list stats
detail: The spec hard-codes PPR. lists.scoring_system_id and /api/players/builder?scoring= exist (gap 15).

feature: Import a ranking sheet (insert, dedupe, tier separator, force Ranked + Tiers)
detail: POST /api/lists/[id]/players/bulk (skips duplicates) plus tier PATCH cover it. Avoid the spec bugs: the 'Added 0' toast and the empty trailing tier.

feature: Import source: Scout AI · Week N · position
detail: Needs a stored Scout AI weekly ranking with tiers.

feature: Import source: Experts · Rest of season
detail: Needs an expert-consensus ranking feed.

feature: Import source: Mine (Submitted / Saved / Finalized rankings)
detail: Weekly boards exist (big_board_weekly, lists.is_big_board); the weekly_rankings table is unused; the bigBoard and weeklyRanks flags are off. Statuses and per-scoring rankings come from the Rankings section. Interim: import from any of the user's own lists.

feature: Full-screen List view screen and route
detail: /app/lists/[listId] is a redirect to ?list=, pinned by lists-cutover.test.ts. Render a full-screen view in mobile mode under ?list=, or change the route and the test.

feature: Save/unsave control on someone else's list
detail: useToggleFavorite (favourite = Saved tab) and the hero pin action exist. The spec has no control (gap 11).

feature: Real routes and history for grid tab, New list, editor, list view
detail: The spec uses setState only, with no pushState. Next.js routes (/app/lists, /app/lists/new, ?list=) give working back and reload.

feature: Profile › My stuff › Lists entry (preview rows + New list) and Home My stuff tile
detail: profile/page.tsx is 'My stats' with no My stuff; Home shows only RecentlyViewed. The rows should be real lists from useLists, each opening that list.

feature: Create with AI entry point on mobile
detail: generate-ai-button.tsx, generate-ai-modal.tsx and /api/lists/generate exist. CLAUDE.md says keep and restyle; ai-surfaces.test.ts pins it. The prototype has no slot for it.

feature: App list features absent from the mobile spec (delete/trash, duplicate, share, privacy, pin, folders, comments, likes, tags, view count, attach to league, drafted marks, rounds/cost/budget, List/Table/Cards views, Side by side, team lists, position group)
detail: All built (list-gallery-card.tsx, list-detail-hero.tsx, lists-folders.tsx, list-comments-tab.tsx, list-display-store.ts, side-by-side-*.tsx, list-form-dialog.tsx). Decide which survive on mobile and where. Soft delete must stay (business rule 8).

feature: Rankings ↔ Lists switch and Community composer duplication
detail: rootSeg is never rendered; Community › Create › List is a second composer. Rankings and Community are flag-off. Needs an IA ruling (gaps 2 and 8).

feature: Dark-mode success/danger text and the in-phone theme toggle
detail: globals.css --m-tg/--m-tr define the README dark colours, which the spec ignores. theme-store.ts has no toggle UI rendered anywhere. Needs a placement.

feature: Hit targets under 30px
detail: Stat ✕ 20px, merge ✕ 24px, swatches 24px, segments 24px, chips 28px, against the README's 30px minimum. Recommend larger hit areas.

feature: Sheet swipe-to-dismiss and animations
detail: The spec has none (gap 20). sheet.tsx is Radix and tailwindcss-animate is available.

feature: Phone frame and status bar
detail: Prototype chrome. Implement only safe-area insets.
